ideas.pitch: A visual platform that generates custom broken chain sequences, difficulty-target mining sandboxes, and tampered block detectors for educational blockchain puzzle hunts.
ideas.title: ChainSleuth: Interactive Blockchain Puzzle Toolkit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the core mechanics of BlockHunt '26, providing an interactive utility that resonates with event organizers and participants learning hashing and mining.

ideas.pitch: A mini-IDE and testing suite featuring live puzzle contracts with hidden flaws, letting students practice cracking smart contracts against simulated exploit conditions.
ideas.title: SmartGuard: Automated Smart Contract Vulnerability Puzzle Trainer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Taps into the smart contract puzzle stage of the hackathon, offering judges an engaging, hands-on tool for security auditing and debugging.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight local network visualizer designed to simulate consensus finale mechanics, demonstrating live block validation and fork resolution across multiple devices.
ideas.title: ConsensusSim: Laptop-Based Consensus Protocol Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the consensus finale stage explicitly, showcasing genuine distributed systems engineering within a tight timeframe.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight utility that verifies transaction integrity and highlights altered payloads using Merkle trees, exposing injected blocks in real-time.
ideas.title: MerkleTrail: Tamper-Evident Chain Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the tamper-evidence stage of the event, offering a rigorous cryptographic verification tool that appeals to technical judges.

ideas.pitch: An educational web sandbox where participants adjust mining difficulty targets, compute nonces in real-time, and race to mine blocks against a dynamic ledger.
ideas.title: ProofOfWork Race: Browser-Based Difficulty Mining Sandbox
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the beginner-friendly yet technically rigorous mining stage, demonstrating clear mastery of hash functions and proof-of-work fundamentals.
